dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: The Akademiya recently cut back on the budget for education, and that rubbed me the wrong way.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: To better advance research and development, the Akademiya would recruit talented children at an early age.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: I'm the teacher for those children. Seeing them mature into accomplished researchers gives me immense pride.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: But if the Akademiya keeps shaving the budget, it will impact their education.

dialogues.speaker: Darya
dialogues.text: Even from the point of maintaining our prestige, I still don't think it's right.
